I'll calculate the number of days between these two dates.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
from datetime import datetime

start_date = datetime(2015, 12, 17)
end_date = datetime(2019, 2, 24)

difference = (end_date - start_date).days
print(f"Start date: {start_date.date()}")
print(f"End date: {end_date.date()}")
print(f"Number of days: {difference}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
</invoke>

The number of days from 2015-12-17 to 2019-02-24 is **1,165 days**.
